metadata.title: Real-mode HIPAA PHI platform (offline AgentResult scorer)

architectureBrief.description: Regional health system sharing DICOM metadata and care summaries between hospitals with strict PHI controls.
technologyStack: Azure Health Data Services FHIR facade
reviewObjectives: Verify encryption, key custody, and PHI labeling
Assess audit logging completeness for clinical access
constraints: HIPAA BAA in place; US geography only
Break-glass access must be logged with reviewer attestation
Immutability for audit logs minimum one year

inputSummary: HIPAA-aligned imaging and FHIR exchange on Azure with CMK, private endpoints, and audit streaming. Synthetic regulated-health slice for real-mode scoring.

qualityEvidence.notes: Non-production narrative; exemplar JSON only — not legal compliance advice.
